8:7.text: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.

provenance.significance: Part of a continuous transcription of Isaiah 51 as 2 Nephi 8. The quotation is not the finding; the departures are, and they are listed in the note and registered individually in data/isaiah-collation.json.

8:7.note: 1 departure(s) from the KJV: KJV “is” → “I have written”. The departure is the finding, and it is not a paraphrase: KJV Isaiah 51:7 has “the people in whose heart IS my law”, and this reads “in whose heart I HAVE WRITTEN my law”, which is Jeremiah 31:33's “I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts”. A transcription of one prophet takes up another's verb at the one word where it leaves its exemplar. Hardy's apparatus cross-references Jeremiah 31:33 at this verse.
